_schema: recipe_id -> { name, cat: material|structure|gear|food, needs: {item: count}, tool: item_id (held, NOT consumed), makes, count: output qty, extra: {item: count} byproducts, work_sec, desc, hint }. Bench crafting: lay parts, work them. Laid parts total must be <= 4 (BenchPanel.MAX_LAID) and every recipe's needs multiset must be unique. A needs key beginning with '@' is a token: '@raw_fish' matches any raw fish species except bone and rot.

steel_plate.name: Steel Plate
steel_plate.desc: Twenty minutes of blade on rust and the scrap gives up a square edge. Your arm knows it afterwards.
steel_plate.hint: Scrap is only scrap until something cuts it straight.

bolt_handful.name: Handful of Bolts
bolt_handful.desc: Shanks cut short and threaded by hand. Not pretty. They hold.
bolt_handful.hint: Every wall you ever build will want more of these.

copper_coil.name: Copper Coil
copper_coil.desc: Cut the jacket off a dead cable drum and the copper comes out bright as a coin.
copper_coil.hint: The rig is full of cable that will never carry current again.

wire_spool.name: Spool of Wire
wire_spool.desc: Drawn down thin and wound onto an old bobbin. Ties what rope is too fat to tie.
wire_spool.hint: Copper wants to be wire. Give it a file and a bobbin.

kelp_fiber.name: Kelp Fiber
kelp_fiber.desc: Split the fronds down their length, strip the slime, lay them out. Dries into something like hemp.
kelp_fiber.hint: Kelp is rope that hasn't been convinced yet.

shell_grit.name: Shell Grit
shell_grit.desc: Shell crushed to a coarse white salt. Draws water out of anything you bury in it.
shell_grit.hint: There is no salt tin left aboard. There are shells everywhere.

wood_slat.name: Wood Slats
wood_slat.desc: One waterlogged plank ripped into slats. The sawdust smells like a forest you can't picture anymore.
wood_slat.hint: A plank is one thing. Slats are furniture.

foam_block.name: Foam Block
foam_block.desc: The ring wasn't going to save anyone. Cut open it's closed-cell foam — dry, light, warm to lie on.
foam_block.hint: Nobody is coming. Cut the ring.

rope_laid.name: Laid Rope
rope_laid.desc: Three hanks of fiber twisted against each other until they refuse to come apart. Slow work. Good work.

float_buoy.name: Float Buoy
float_buoy.desc: Foam sewn into canvas with a becket spliced on. Marks a spot on water that has no other landmarks.
float_buoy.hint: Wrap the foam before the sea eats it.

fillet_catch.name: Fillet the Catch
fillet_catch.desc: Head off, gut out, two clean sides off the frame. Keep the spine — bone still takes an edge.
fillet_catch.hint: Any fish, and something sharp. Don't eat it raw if you can help it.

cured_fillet.name: Cured Fillet
cured_fillet.desc: Packed in crushed shell and left to give up its water. Keeps for weeks. Tastes like the sea apologising.
cured_fillet.hint: Salt is how you argue with time.

glow_worm_cooked.name: Seared Glow Worm
glow_worm_cooked.desc: A minute on hot steel and the light goes out of it. What's left is honest meat.
glow_worm_cooked.hint: Raw ones bite back on the way down. Sear it first.

bloom_lamp_kit.name: Bloom Lamp
bloom_lamp_kit.desc: Bloom-kelp sealed in a scrap housing. Cold teal light, no power needed — and what walks at night honors it.
bloom_lamp_kit.hint: Kelp glows for weeks in a sealed housing. The crew knew.

leanto_kit.name: Lean-To
leanto_kit.desc: Canvas over a driftwood frame. A pocket of warmth anywhere on the rig.
leanto_kit.hint: The sea gives back wood and canvas. Make a roof of them.

walkway_kit.name: Plank Walkway
walkway_kit.desc: A lashed plank section. Bridges a gap, extends a deck.
walkway_kit.hint: Two sound planks make a path where there wasn't one.

barricade_kit.name: Barricade
barricade_kit.desc: Scrap plate on a wood brace. Waist-high, storm-solid.
barricade_kit.hint: Plate the gyre coughs up still remembers being a wall.

drop_net_kit.name: Drop Net
drop_net_kit.desc: A weighted mesh on a winch line. Lower it off an edge, let the sea walk in, haul.
drop_net_kit.hint: Set it before dusk — the night shift swims shallower.

bedroll_kit.name: Bedroll
bedroll_kit.desc: Foam sandwiched in doubled canvas, rolled and strapped. Somewhere to lie down that isn't steel.
bedroll_kit.hint: You have been sleeping sitting up. Stop that.

locker_kit.name: Steel Locker
locker_kit.desc: Two plates folded into a box and bolted at the seam. Puts your things somewhere the wind can't take them.
locker_kit.hint: Fold the plate over the edge of the bench. Hit it until it's a corner.

rain_catcher_kit.name: Rain Catcher
rain_catcher_kit.desc: Tarp slung on guys with a pipe running down to a vessel. The North Sea gives fresh water for free if you ask it right.
rain_catcher_kit.hint: Sag the middle. Water finds the low point on its own.

brazier_kit.name: Brazier
brazier_kit.desc: A cut drum lined with broken firebrick, vents punched round the base. Fire you can stand close to.
brazier_kit.hint: The ceramic keeps the steel from burning through by the second night.

chair_kit.name: Deck Chair
chair_kit.desc: Slats bolted into an X, canvas slung between. Somewhere to sit and watch the water do nothing.
chair_kit.hint: You are allowed to sit down.

workbench_kit.name: Workbench
workbench_kit.desc: Plank top, steel skin over one end for hot work, legs torqued down hard. A second place to make things.
workbench_kit.hint: One bench on the whole rig is one bench too few.

drying_rack_kit.name: Drying Rack
drying_rack_kit.desc: An A-frame strung with line. Hang fish, hang kelp, hang the shirt off your back.
drying_rack_kit.hint: Wind and time do the work. You just have to hang it up.

planter_kit.name: Planter Box
planter_kit.desc: Plate folded into a tray, seams tarred, packed with rotted fiber for soil. Something green, on purpose, for once.
planter_kit.hint: It won't feed you for months. Do it anyway.

shelf_kit.name: Wall Shelf
shelf_kit.desc: A slat and a bracket, screwed to a bulkhead. Puts your things at eye height, where you can see you own them.
shelf_kit.hint: Level it. You'll be looking at it every day.

wall_panel_kit.name: Wall Panel
wall_panel_kit.desc: Plate skinned onto a pipe frame. Closes a gap in a room and makes it a room.
wall_panel_kit.hint: Walls are how you decide where inside is.

lamp_post_kit.name: Lamp Post
lamp_post_kit.desc: Bloom-mucus sealed in a jar and wired to the head of a standing pipe. Marks a path across the deck at night.
lamp_post_kit.hint: Set them in a line. Coming home in the dark is easier with a line.

windbreak_kit.name: Windbreak
windbreak_kit.desc: Canvas stretched between two staked pipes. Doesn't look like much until the wind swings north.
windbreak_kit.hint: The cold isn't the temperature. It's the wind.

rug_kit.name: Deck Rug
rug_kit.desc: Fiber hooked through doubled canvas until it's thick enough to kneel on. Takes hours. Nobody made you do it.
rug_kit.hint: Steel is cold through boots. This isn't.

throwing_hook.name: Throwing Hook
throwing_hook.desc: A mini anchor lashed to a heaving line. Takes back what the gyre holds.
throwing_hook.hint: A mini anchor from the machine shop; rope from the crane deck.

crude_knife.name: Crude Knife
crude_knife.desc: A scrap shard ground to an edge and bound to a wrapped grip. Close, ugly work.
crude_knife.hint: Scrap metal and a wrap of rope. The pump room has both.

crude_spear.name: Crude Spear
crude_spear.desc: A shard lashed to a driftwood pole. Reach — put the point in them before a claw finds you.
crude_spear.hint: A shard, a pole, and rope to lash it. Beats a claw at arm's length.

honed_knife.name: Honed Knife
honed_knife.desc: The same ugly shard, worked back to a real edge and trued along the spine. It goes in now instead of tearing.
honed_knife.hint: A file and patience. Nothing on this rig is finished the first time.

honed_spear.name: Honed Spear
honed_spear.desc: Point filed narrow, a bone barb set behind it so nothing walks itself back off the shaft.
honed_spear.hint: The barb is the whole difference. Ask anything you've lost.

tool_belt.name: Tool Belt
tool_belt.desc: Canvas pockets stitched onto a rope waist. Keeps your hands empty and your tools where your hands expect them.
tool_belt.hint: You keep going back for the one thing you didn't bring.

storm_lantern.name: Storm Lantern
storm_lantern.desc: Bloom-mucus behind glass in a screwed steel cage. Wind can't touch it, rain can't touch it. It just burns.
storm_lantern.hint: Light that doesn't go out when the weather turns is worth a day's work.

patched_boots.name: Patched Boots
patched_boots.desc: Hose split for soles, canvas uppers, every seam paid with tar. Dry feet. You'd forgotten what that was.
patched_boots.hint: Wet feet is how the cold gets in and stays in.

storage_bin_kit.name: Storage Bin
storage_bin_kit.desc: Deck planks knocked together on a scrap-angle frame. Holds what you are not carrying, and the sea can have the rest.
storage_bin_kit.hint: Driftwood off the gyre and one piece of scrap. Cheaper than a job box, and it does the same job.

canvas_scrap.name: Canvas Scrap
canvas_scrap.desc: A whole tarp cut down into workable squares. Straight cuts, salt-stiff edges, and suddenly you have material instead of a sheet.
canvas_scrap.hint: The sea keeps bringing tarps in. It does not bring sofas.

pipe_length.name: Length of Pipe
pipe_length.desc: A plate beaten around a form until its edges meet, then bolted down the seam. It is not round and it does not need to be.
pipe_length.hint: Everything upright out here started as something flat.

door_kit.name: Wooden Door
door_kit.desc: Two planks ledged and braced into a leaf, hung on bolt-hinges in a driftwood frame. It swings, it latches, and a room with a door in it is a room you can shut.
door_kit.hint: A doorway is just a hole until something hangs in it.
